title: hive-pool read: request body
description: Reads records of one kind from the Pool, by identity or by query, as a projection. Read-only: nothing is recorded and the request may be repeated freely. See spec/pool.md, Reading the Pool.

selector.description: An identity selects one record and is not_found when absent. The query fields select many and an empty match is an empty list. Fields that do not apply to the kind are a schema violation of the operation.

id.description: The record's own identity: a task_id for an item or an Imperative, a hold_id, an admission_id, and so on.

task_id.description: Records that concern one item: its holds and admissions.

states.description: Item, hold or rule states to include, in the kind's own vocabulary.

ready.description: Items only: queued, not blocked and not actively held, each read on the item and on its ancestors, not a decision item, not a Target and not a Prey that has a Hunt beneath it.

due_before.description: Holds with an until time, rules with an expiry time: those due at or before this instant.
